findings.title: The cancellation safety allowlist cannot settle pre-send Effects or mint required no-exposure proof for all reachable tuples
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 requires cancellation from every reachable nonterminal improvement tuple, effect reconciliation, genuine rollback wherever exposure may exist, and eventual separately owned cleanup only after protected settlement.
evidence: Normative §15.5 says that while cancellation is not NONE, ordinary candidate, rollout, control, widening, promotion, and new business-effect edges are rejected. Its closed safety allowlist names IX06 variants, IRB01-IRB07/IRB09, Effect reconciliation rows, U09/A18, and IX cleanup.

E02 `INTENT_RECORDED->CANCELLED_BEFORE_SEND` and E03 `READY_TO_SEND->CANCELLED_BEFORE_SEND` are cancellation settlement edges, not reconciliation rows, and are not named in that allowlist. A reachable IX01-first race after IR37 has created a widening Effect at INTENT_RECORDED (or after E01 at READY_TO_SEND) therefore leaves the Effect live once ordinary Effect edges are rejected.

IX06-UR/UQ can move the rollout to reconciliation but preserve the original Effect; no Effect edge from INTENT_RECORDED or READY_TO_SEND enters RECONCILING. IX06-NR/NQ can preserve an N classifier, but they do not transition the Effect to a terminal, so IX03's `all effects settled` guard still cannot pass.

A separate reachable case is IX01 at `CANARY_READY` after IR04 created the active child but before WorkerStarted. IR34/IR35 are ordinary rollout rows and thus rejected after cancellation; IX06-NR/NQ omit CANARY_READY; IX03 with rollback IDLE requires a protected NoExposureReceipt, but no allowed row creates that generation-bound receipt. Pre-canary DISABLED/ENABLEMENT_REVIEW/CANARY_PENDING_APPROVAL cancellation has the same undefined receipt-production problem when IX03 insists on a protected all-target NoExposureReceipt.
The round-10 correction claims IX01-first witnesses and a closed X/N/unsettled cancellation partition, but the listed source and Effect-state gaps remain in the normative rows.
findings.impact: Permitted cancellation-first orderings deadlock before IX03/IX04 even though no external application occurred. An implementation that invents an unlisted receipt or Effect transition would violate the closed-manifest rule; relaxing IX03 instead could permit cleanup without proved classification.
findings.required_correction: Extend the closed cancellation safety allowlist with exact synchronized pre-send Effect cancellation/settlement rows and exact N-classifier production for every reachable pre-exposure rollout, including CANARY_READY with an active generation. Each row must fence the generation, settle the precise Effect set, create or bind the protected no-exposure receipt once, preserve deterministic replay, and leave IX03 as the sole cancellation cleanup owner. Add IX01-before-E02/E03, IX01-at-each-pre-exposure-rollout, and child-terminal-before/after-IX01 witnesses.

findings.title: Candidate revocation and evidence invalidation are undefined after FROZEN or during an active rollout
findings.requirement: PLAN §8.4 requires digest changes to enter EVIDENCE_STALE and partitions candidate revocation into protected N, X, or unsettled reconciliation without permitting stale authority or exposure to continue.
evidence: IC30 legally changes candidate `SHADOW_PASSED->FROZEN` on a safety, identity, or telemetry hold, and FROZEN is explicitly nonterminal. The only outgoing FROZEN row is IC31 back to SHADOW_PASSED. Every IC32 revocation-entry row has candidate source SHADOW_PASSED (or REVOKED for continuation); none accepts FROZEN->REVOKED.

IC24 legally changes `SHADOW_PASSED->EVIDENCE_STALE` on a bound digest change, but it changes no rollout, Effect, rollback, or authority coordinate. Normative §15 reachability says canary states require candidate `SHADOW_PASSED|FROZEN|REVOKED`, so IC24 during CANARY_RUNNING, widening, promotion, or observation produces an impossible tuple and rejects rather than fencing exposure.

Once EVIDENCE_STALE is reached before rollout, its only refresh rows IC25-IC27 return to proposal/offline/shadow stages; there is no revocation row from EVIDENCE_STALE if a revocation arrives while the stale state is pending.

The IC32 checker prose claims equality against actual reachable revocation coordinates including candidate source, but the row union cannot contain FROZEN or EVIDENCE_STALE sources. A future generated check does not supply the missing legal edges in this plan-only closed manifest.
findings.impact: A revocation can be unrecordable while a candidate is held or stale, and an active-rollout digest change either rejects or lacks atomic fencing/rollback classification. This contradicts revocation totality and can leave authority or exposure governed by invalid evidence.
findings.required_correction: Add exact synchronized FROZEN/EVIDENCE_STALE revocation rows and active-rollout digest-change rows. Partition each reachable rollout/Effect coordinate into protected N, protected X, or unsettled reconciliation; atomically fence grants and sends; reuse an existing saga or create exactly one; and assign later cleanup only to IR13C, IRB08, or IX03. Extend the generated equality and ordering witnesses to IC30-before-revocation, IC24-before-revocation, and digest-change during canary/widening/promotion/observation.
